name: hammurabi-babylon-rise
description: Hammurabi took the throne of a modest city on the Euphrates and began conquests that built a great Mesopotamian realm.

name: nabopolassar-neo-babylonian-empire
description: A Chaldean leader seized Babylon from Assyrian control and founded the dynasty that would rebuild the city in splendour.

name: alexander-invades-persia-granicus
description: A young Macedonian king crossed into Asia with his army and began the conquests that toppled the Persian Empire.

name: arsaces-founds-parthian-empire
description: A nomadic chieftain seized a province from the Seleucids and began the dynasty that later rivalled Rome in the East.

name: modu-shanyu-xiongnu-empire
description: A steppe prince killed his father to seize power and united the nomadic tribes into a confederation that menaced China.
